name: stygian_guard
description: a Stygian Guard (Fall from Heaven), an octopus-headed warrior: a green octopus head with barnacles on its mantle, glowing cyan eyes and a beard of pale green tentacles hanging over the chest, dark green scaled armour with gold trim and barnacled pauldrons, a gold belt with a round buckle, armoured green boots, a tall golden trident held upright in his LEFT hand, and a round green spiral-shell shield on his RIGHT arm
hands: the golden trident stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and the spiral-shell shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the golden trident is lifted up over the head with its prongs pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the golden trident cocked behind the head with its prongs hanging down behind the shoulders, the spiral-shell shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the golden trident is level, its prongs pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: trident arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the golden trident's prongs stabbing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the spiral-shell shield arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the golden trident carries on down until its prongs nearly touch the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the face tentacles trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the golden trident lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the octopus head snaps back toward the upper-left, the glowing eyes squeezed shut, the face tentacles flying, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the spiral-shell shield flung out to the left, trident arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the golden trident dipping, the spiral-shell shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, trident arm flung up, the spiral-shell shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the octopus head droops, the golden trident lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the golden trident's prongs resting on the ground, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the golden trident slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the face tentacles spread over his chest; the golden trident lies on the ground at the lower-right; the spiral-shell shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the tentacles flop, the spiral-shell shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the cyan eyes dark, the tentacles limp, the golden trident and the spiral-shell shield on the ground beside him
